plugin.name: Splinter Cell Chaos Theory Fusion Fix
ResX.description: Use 0 to select the desktop resolution. Set both dimensions to override it.
ResY.description: Use 0 to select the desktop resolution. Set both dimensions to override it.
RawInputMouse.description: Collects mouse movement independently of rendering to avoid lost input. Requires a restart.
RawInputMouseRawData.description: Ignores Windows pointer speed and acceleration for raw mouse movement. Requires a restart.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto puts the HUD at the screen edges. A ratio such as 4:3, 16:9 or 21:9 keeps it in a centered box; 4:3 is the original layout. Applies immediately.
SkipIntro.description: Skip the intro logos, as with the native -nointro command line option.
SkipPressStart.description: Skip the initial Press Any Key to Continue screen.
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a window at the chosen resolution (at the desktop resolution it covers the screen, its frame outside it) or a borderless window covering the monitor. Alt+Enter switches between fullscreen and the window mode.
FullScreenRefreshRateInHz.description: The fullscreen refresh rate: the highest one of the resolution up to this value. 0 uses the adapter's default rate.
ShadowMapResolution.description: Shadow map size in pixels, for example 2048, 4096 or 8192. 0 keeps the size of the game's Shadow Quality option (512, 1024 or 2048); larger maps give sharper shadow edges and use more GPU memory.
HardShadows.description: Sharp shadow edges instead of the game's soft, blurred ones, with the same shadow darkness. Needs Shader Model 2.0 or 3.0; the shadow map size decides how fine the edges are.
FPSLimit.description: Caps the native frame pacing. 0 is unlimited; -1 follows the current monitor refresh rate. Applies immediately. The default 60 FPS avoids high-frame-rate gameplay issues.
BlacklistIndicators.description: Glow in Shadows makes Sam's indicators work as in Blacklist: dark in the light, glowing in the shadows, and weaker the more visible you are. Glow in Light inverts this.
GogglesLightColor.description: Original keeps the game's own lights. The other colors are the Ops Suit Light colors from Blacklist. Restart required.
LightSyncRGB.description: Synchronize supported Logitech RGB hardware with game events. Requires Logitech G HUB.

MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Language tag for Advanced Options and other plugins. auto follows the game language. Edit in the hub or CFG, then reopen Advanced Options.
menu.title: Advanced Options
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the normal gameplay camera field of view. 1.0 keeps the intended framing; larger values widen the view. Scripted, aiming and gadget cameras keep their own framing. Extra widening is limited to 150 degrees across; 1.0 remains neutral.
FMVWidescreenMode.description: Original aspect shows the movies as the game does, whole inside its centred 4:3 frame with black bars around them. Fill fits the whole movie to the screen, without cutting anything off or stretching it.
MouseSensitivity.description: Multiplies raw mouse movement. Applies immediately while raw mouse input is enabled.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Restores the settings on this plugin page.
menu.restartwarning: Restart the game to apply these settings.
menu.presethelp: Choose a preset, then confirm to apply it.
MAIN.HudAspectRatioConstraint.descriptio: Auto uses the full screen width. Set a ratio such as 4:3, 16:9 or 21:9 to keep the HUD in a centered area. Applies immediately.
menu.rawsensitivity.label: Raw sensitivity
MAIN.PauseOnFocusLoss.description: Pauses the game and its sound while another window is active, as the original does. Off keeps the game running in the background in windowed and borderless modes. Applies immediately.
MAIN.ConfineCursor.description: Keeps the mouse cursor inside the game window while the game is active, so it can't move to another monitor. Applies immediately.
MAIN.CheckForUpdates.description: Once per start, asks fusionfix.io whether a newer version of the fix is out and tells you in the game. Off makes no network request.
MAIN.SaveLocation.description: Where profiles and saves are kept. ProgramData is the game's own place (ProgramData\Ubisoft\Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell Chaos Theory\Profiles, a hidden folder), Documents uses Documents\My Games\Splinter Cell Chaos Theory, Game Folder the Save folder next to System. Saves are not moved: copy the folders over to keep playing them. Restart required.
MAIN.GamepadIcons.description: Button names in prompts while a pad is used. Auto uses Xbox names; keyboard and mouse input restores keyboard prompts.
MAIN.Vibration.description: Lets the pad rumble with shots, explosions and hits. Applies immediately.
update.availablehub: {name} {version} is available. FusionFixHub opens when you close the game.
startup.unsupported: This executable is not supported by the Fusion Fix. Use the original Chaos Theory single-player retail or Steam executable and the latest ASI loader from the fix package. The game starts without the fix.
update.title: Update available
